unit-circle.definition:
在平面直角坐标系中，以原点 $O$ 为圆心、半径为 $1$ 的圆称为**单位圆**，方程为

$$x^2 + y^2 = 1$$

从 $x$ 轴正半轴出发逆时针转过角 $\theta$，终边与单位圆的交点坐标恰好是 $(\cos\theta, \sin\theta)$。

这就是三角函数的**单位圆定义**：它把三角函数从「直角三角形的边长之比」推广到了一切实数的角，是理解周期性、诱导公式的关键工具。
unit-circle.definitionEn:
In the Cartesian plane, the circle centered at the origin $O$ with radius $1$ is the **unit circle**, with equation

$$x^2 + y^2 = 1$$

Starting from the positive x-axis and rotating counterclockwise by an angle $\theta$, the terminal side meets the unit circle at the point $(\cos\theta, \sin\theta)$.

This is the **unit-circle definition** of the trigonometric functions: it extends them from ratios of triangle sides to all real angles and is the key to understanding periodicity and the reduction formulas.

triangle.definition:
由不在同一直线上的三条线段首尾顺次相接组成的封闭图形叫做**三角形**。三个内角之和恒为 $180^\circ$，即 $\pi$ 弧度。

三角形是解三角形与三角学的起点：正弦定理、余弦定理、面积公式都建立在它的边角关系之上。按角可分为锐角、直角、钝角三角形；按边可分为等边、等腰、不等边三角形。
triangle.definitionEn:
A **triangle** is the closed figure formed by three line segments joining three non-collinear points. Its three interior angles always sum to $180^\circ$, i.e. $\pi$ radians.

Triangles are the starting point of trigonometry: the law of sines, the law of cosines, and the area formulas all rest on their side-angle relations. They are classified by angles (acute, right, obtuse) or by sides (equilateral, isosceles, scalene).

angle-radian.definition:
**角**可以看成一条射线绕它的端点旋转形成的图形：旋转方向逆时针时角为正，顺时针时为负，这样角就可以取任意大小的实数，不再限于 $0^\circ$ 到 $360^\circ$。所有与角 $\alpha$ 终边相同的角组成一个集合 $\{\beta \mid \beta = \alpha + k\cdot 360^\circ,\ k \in \mathbb{Z}\}$。

**弧度制**换了一种度量方式：长度等于半径的弧所对的圆心角叫做 $1$ 弧度的角，记作 $1\,\mathrm{rad}$。一个周角是 $360^\circ$，而它的弧长是 $2\pi r$，所以 $360^\circ = 2\pi$ 弧度，即 $180^\circ = \pi$ 弧度。

弧度制的最大好处是把角与实数一一对应，使角成为真正可以当作自变量参与运算的量，从而使三角函数成为实数集上的函数，也是后面导数公式 $\dfrac{d}{dx}\sin x = \cos x$ 成立的前提。

扇形中的三个量 $l = |\alpha| r$、$S = \dfrac{1}{2} l r = \dfrac{1}{2} |\alpha| r^2$ 在弧度制下形式极其简洁，这也是弧度制被广泛使用的原因之一。
angle-radian.definitionEn:
An **angle** can be viewed as a ray rotating about its endpoint: counterclockwise rotation gives a positive angle, clockwise gives a negative one. In this way an angle can be any real number and is no longer limited to $0^\circ$ to $360^\circ$. All angles sharing the same terminal side with $\alpha$ form the set $\{\beta \mid \beta = \alpha + k\cdot 360^\circ,\ k \in \mathbb{Z}\}$.

**Radian measure** is another way to measure an angle: the central angle subtended by an arc equal in length to the radius is called an angle of $1$ radian, written $1\,\mathrm{rad}$. A full turn is $360^\circ$ and its arc length is $2\pi r$, so $360^\circ = 2\pi$ radians, i.e. $180^\circ = \pi$ radians.

The great advantage of radians is that they put angles in one-to-one correspondence with real numbers, so an angle becomes a genuine independent variable. This is what makes the trigonometric functions functions on the reals, and it is exactly why the derivative formula $\dfrac{d}{dx}\sin x = \cos x$ holds.

For a sector, the three quantities take their cleanest form in radians: $l = |\alpha| r$ and $S = \dfrac{1}{2} l r = \dfrac{1}{2} |\alpha| r^2$.

trigonometric-definition.definition:
回忆初中：在直角三角形中，$\sin A = \dfrac{\text{对边}}{\text{斜边}}$，$\cos A = \dfrac{\text{邻边}}{\text{斜边}}$，$\tan A = \dfrac{\text{对边}}{\text{邻边}}$。但这样定义只能处理锐角，无法定义 $150^\circ$ 或 $-\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ 的三角函数值。

**单位圆定义法**解决了这个问题。在平面直角坐标系中作单位圆（半径为 $1$、圆心在原点），设角 $\alpha$ 的终边与单位圆交于点 $P(x, y)$，规定

$$\sin\alpha = y,\qquad \cos\alpha = x,\qquad \tan\alpha = \frac{y}{x}\ (x \neq 0).$$

换句话说，**余弦是横坐标，正弦是纵坐标**。因为点 $P$ 一定在单位圆上，所以 $x^2 + y^2 = 1$，立即得到 $\sin^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha = 1$。

当 $\alpha$ 是锐角时，取点 $P$ 向 $x$ 轴作垂线得到的直角三角形正好说明：$y$ 是 $\alpha$ 的对边（斜边为 $1$）、$x$ 是邻边，所以新定义与初中定义完全一致——新定义只是推广，并没有改变。
trigonometric-definition.definitionEn:
In junior high we learned that in a right triangle, $\sin A = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}$, $\cos A = \dfrac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}}$, $\tan A = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}$. But such a definition only handles acute angles; it cannot give a meaning to $\sin 150^\circ$ or $\cos\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)$.

The **unit-circle definition** fixes this. Draw the unit circle (centred at the origin, radius $1$) in the coordinate plane and let the terminal side of angle $\alpha$ meet the circle at $P(x, y)$. Define

$$\sin\alpha = y,\qquad \cos\alpha = x,\qquad \tan\alpha = \frac{y}{x}\ (x \neq 0).$$

In words: **the cosine is the x-coordinate and the sine is the y-coordinate**. Since $P$ lies on the unit circle, $x^2 + y^2 = 1$ immediately, giving $\sin^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha = 1$.

When $\alpha$ is acute, dropping a perpendicular from $P$ to the x-axis produces a right triangle in which $y$ is the side opposite $\alpha$ (the hypotenuse being $1$) and $x$ is the adjacent side. So the new definition agrees exactly with the old one — it only generalises it.

sine-function.definition:
**正弦函数**定义为

$$y = \sin x \quad (x \in \mathbb{R}),$$

即对每个实数 $x$（弧度值），取单位圆上角 $x$ 所对应点的纵坐标。它的图像是一条光滑的波浪曲线，叫做**正弦曲线**（sinusoid）。

正弦函数有两个标志性特征：一是**有界**，输出永远夹在 $-1$ 和 $1$ 之间；二是**周期**，每当自变量增加 $2\pi$，图像就完整重复一次。由于 $\sin(-x) = -\sin x$，它是**奇函数**，图像关于原点中心对称。

正弦曲线是描述一切振动与波动的基本模型：单摆、弹簧、交流电、声波、光波，在理想情形下都是正弦形的。物理学中写成 $A\sin(\omega t + \varphi)$，其中 $A$ 是振幅、$\omega$ 是角频率、$\varphi$ 是初相。

它还有一个漂亮的导数性质：$\dfrac{d}{dx}\sin x = \cos x$，第二次求导就回到 $-\sin x$，这正说明正弦是「振动方程」$y'' + y = 0$ 的解。
sine-function.definitionEn:
The **sine function** is defined by

$$y = \sin x \quad (x \in \mathbb{R}),$$

mapping each real number $x$ (in radians) to the y-coordinate of the corresponding point on the unit circle. Its graph is a smooth wave called a **sine curve** (sinusoid).

Two features define it: it is **bounded**, never leaving $[-1,1]$; and it is **periodic**, the graph repeating itself completely whenever $x$ grows by $2\pi$. Because $\sin(-x) = -\sin x$ it is an **odd function**, symmetric about the origin.

The sine curve is the basic model for every vibration and wave: pendulums, springs, alternating current, sound and light in the ideal case. In physics it appears as $A\sin(\omega t + \varphi)$, where $A$ is the amplitude, $\omega$ the angular frequency and $\varphi$ the initial phase.

It also has a beautiful derivative property: $\dfrac{d}{dx}\sin x = \cos x$, and differentiating twice returns $-\sin x$, showing that the sine solves the oscillation equation $y'' + y = 0$.

cosine-function.definition:
**余弦函数**定义为

$$y = \cos x \quad (x \in \mathbb{R}),$$

即单位圆上角 $x$ 所对应点的横坐标。它的图像叫做**余弦曲线**，形状与正弦曲线完全相同，只是整体向左平移了 $\dfrac{\pi}{2}$：

$$\cos x = \sin\left(x + \frac{\pi}{2}\right).$$

与正弦不同，余弦是**偶函数**：$\cos(-x) = \cos x$，图像关于 $y$ 轴对称（而正弦图像关于原点对称）。在 $x = 0$ 处余弦取到最大值 $1$，正弦则从 $0$ 出发上升。

余弦在几何与物理中的角色同样核心。它是向量点积的组成部分（$\vec a\cdot\vec b = |\vec a||\vec b|\cos\theta$），是傅里叶级数中与正弦配对的另一组基函数，也是描述简谐运动时常用的初相位选择。

它的导数是 $\dfrac{d}{dx}\cos x = -\sin x$——注意那个负号，这正是「余弦过峰值时斜率为零，随后向负方向变化」的体现。
cosine-function.definitionEn:
The **cosine function** is defined by

$$y = \cos x \quad (x \in \mathbb{R}),$$

sending $x$ to the x-coordinate of the corresponding point on the unit circle. Its graph, the **cosine curve**, has exactly the same shape as the sine curve but is shifted left by $\dfrac{\pi}{2}$:

$$\cos x = \sin\left(x + \frac{\pi}{2}\right).$$

Unlike the sine, the cosine is **even**: $\cos(-x) = \cos x$, so its graph is symmetric about the y-axis (while the sine graph is symmetric about the origin). The cosine attains its maximum $1$ at $x = 0$, whereas the sine starts at $0$ and rises.

The cosine plays an equally central role in geometry and physics. It appears in the dot product ($\vec a\cdot\vec b = |\vec a||\vec b|\cos\theta$), it is the partner basis function of the sine in Fourier series, and it is often the natural choice of phase for simple harmonic motion.

Its derivative is $\dfrac{d}{dx}\cos x = -\sin x$ — note the minus sign, which reflects that at its peak the cosine has zero slope and then decreases.

examples.problem: 求函数 $y = 2\cos\left(\frac{x}{2} + \frac{\pi}{6}\right)$ 的周期与最小值。
examples.solution: 周期 $T = \frac{2\pi}{\frac{1}{2}} = 4\pi$。余弦的最小值为 $-1$，故 $y$ 的最小值为 $-2$，在 $\frac{x}{2} + \frac{\pi}{6} = \pi + 2k\pi$，即 $x = \frac{5\pi}{3} + 4k\pi$ 时取得。

examples.solution: $\cos\left(-\frac{5\pi}{6}\right) = \cos\frac{5\pi}{6} = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$。

expression.noteEn: On the unit circle, cos x is the x-coordinate of the intersection point.

tangent-function.definition:
**正切函数**定义为正弦与余弦之商：

$$y = \tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x},\qquad x \neq \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi,\ k \in \mathbb{Z}.$$

由于分母 $\cos x$ 会让整个式子在这些点失效，凡是 $\cos x = 0$ 的地方正切都没有定义，图像在那里出现**竖直渐近线**，函数值冲向正无穷或负无穷。因此正切函数的定义域是「去掉一些点」的实数集，而不是整个 $\mathbb{R}$。

正切的周期只有 $\pi$（而不是 $2\pi$），因为在区间长度 $\pi$ 之内图像已完整重复一次：

$$\tan(x + \pi) = \tan x.$$

它还是**奇函数**：$\tan(-x) = -\tan x$，图像关于原点中心对称。在每个区间 $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi,\ \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\right)$ 上它严格单调递增，值域覆盖全部实数。

几何上正切就是直线的**斜率**：单位圆上与角 $x$ 终边相同的直线斜率恰为 $\tan x$，这也是「正切」这个名字的由来。
tangent-function.definitionEn:
The **tangent function** is defined as the quotient of sine and cosine:

$$y = \tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x},\qquad x \neq \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi,\ k \in \mathbb{Z}.$$

Because the denominator $\cos x$ vanishes at some points, the tangent is undefined wherever $\cos x = 0$; the graph has a **vertical asymptote** there and the values shoot off to $+\infty$ or $-\infty$. Its domain is therefore the real line with those points removed, not all of $\mathbb{R}$.

The tangent has period $\pi$ only (not $2\pi$), because the pattern already repeats within an interval of length $\pi$:

$$\tan(x + \pi) = \tan x.$$

It is also an **odd function**, $\tan(-x) = -\tan x$, with a graph symmetric about the origin. On every interval $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi,\ \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\right)$ it is strictly increasing, and its range covers every real number.

Geometrically the tangent is a **slope**: the slope of the line along the terminal side of angle $x$ equals $\tan x$, which is exactly where the name comes from.

formulas.note: 定义式，要求 $\cos x \neq 0$
formulas.noteEn: The definition, requiring $\cos x \neq 0$

formulas.note: 最小正周期为 $\pi$，是正弦余弦周期的一半

examples.problem: 比较 $\tan 1$ 与 $\tan 2$ 的大小。

trig-transform.definition:
一切正弦型的波形都可以写成

$$y = A\sin(\omega x + \varphi) + B \quad (A \neq 0,\ \omega > 0).$$

它的图像可以由最基础的 $y = \sin x$ 经过四种变换拼出来：**振幅变换**、**周期变换**、**相位变换**、**上下平移**。

- $A$ 叫**振幅**，把图像纵向拉伸为原来的 $|A|$ 倍，值域变为 $[-|A|, |A|]$；$A<0$ 时还要上下翻转。
- $\omega$ 决定**周期** $T = \dfrac{2\pi}{\omega}$：$\omega > 1$ 图像横向压缩变密，$0 < \omega < 1$ 则横向拉伸变疏。
- $\varphi$ 是**初相**，把图像水平平移 $\left|\dfrac{\varphi}{\omega}\right|$：$\varphi > 0$ 向左移，$\varphi < 0$ 向右移。
- $B$ 把整条曲线上下平移 $B$ 个单位，于是值域变成 $[B-|A|,\ B+|A|]$。

需要注意顺序：横向变换（$\omega$）与水平平移（$\varphi$）的先后会影响对平移量的理解，规范做法是先把 $\omega x + \varphi$ 提出写成 $\omega\left(x + \dfrac{\varphi}{\omega}\right)$，再按「先伸缩后平移」逐步操作。

四个量都可以从图像上直接读出：最高点与最低点的平均值给出 $B$，高度一半给出 $|A|$，相邻两个零点的距离给出半个周期，最先上升到最高点的横坐标给出相位。
trig-transform.definitionEn:
Every sinusoidal wave can be written

$$y = A\sin(\omega x + \varphi) + B \quad (A \neq 0,\ \omega > 0).$$

Its graph is built from the base curve $y = \sin x$ by four transformations: **amplitude**, **period**, **phase** and **vertical shift**.

- $A$ is the **amplitude**: it stretches the graph vertically by $|A|$, making the range $[-|A|, |A|]$; a negative $A$ also flips it vertically.
- $\omega$ fixes the **period** $T = \dfrac{2\pi}{\omega}$: $\omega > 1$ compresses the graph horizontally, $0 < \omega < 1$ stretches it.
- $\varphi$ is the **initial phase**, shifting the graph horizontally by $\left|\dfrac{\varphi}{\omega}\right|$: left for $\varphi > 0$, right for $\varphi < 0$.
- $B$ moves the whole curve up or down by $B$, giving the range $[B-|A|,\ B+|A|]$.

The order matters: horizontal scaling by $\omega$ and the horizontal shift $\varphi$ interact, so the standard trick is to rewrite $\omega x + \varphi$ as $\omega\left(x + \dfrac{\varphi}{\omega}\right)$ before applying the steps.

All four parameters can be read straight off a graph: the average of the highest and lowest values gives $B$, half the height gives $|A|$, the distance between two consecutive zeros gives half a period, and the first maximum fixes the phase.

formulas.note: 一般正弦型函数的四参数形式
formulas.noteEn: The four-parameter general sinusoidal form

formulas.note: 周期由角频率决定，$\omega$ 越大周期越短
formulas.noteEn: The period is set by the angular frequency; larger $\omega$ means a shorter period

formulas.note: 振幅与值域，用于从图像反推参数

formulas.noteEn: Using a period transformation: to obtain a period $T$, take $\omega = \frac{2\pi}{T}$

formulas.note: 相位变换的典型例子：向左平移 $\frac{\pi}{2}$ 把正弦变成余弦
formulas.noteEn: A typical phase shift: translating left by $\frac{\pi}{2}$ turns the sine into the cosine

图像可由 $y = \sin x$ 作四种变换（伸缩、平移）得到，也可以直接「五点法」描点作图
横向平移量是 $\frac{\varphi}{\omega}$ 而不是 $\varphi$，这是最容易出错的地方
对称轴出现在取最值的横坐标处，由 $\omega x + \varphi = \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi$ 解出
$\varphi > 0$ 时图像左移（相位超前），$\varphi < 0$ 时图像右移（相位滞后）

examples.problem: 把 $y = \sin x$ 的图像先横向压缩为原来的 $\frac{1}{2}$，再向右平移 $\frac{\pi}{6}$，得到什么函数？
examples.solution: 横向压缩为 $\frac{1}{2}$ 得到 $y = \sin 2x$；再向右平移 $\frac{\pi}{6}$ 得 $y = \sin 2\left(x - \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \sin\left(2x - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$。注意平移量 $\frac{\pi}{6}$ 必须写在括号内乘上 $\omega$。

examples.problem: 某正弦曲线最高点为 $(2, 3)$，最低点为 $(6, -1)$，求它的解析式。
examples.solution: 最大值 $3$、最小值 $-1$，故 $B = \frac{3+(-1)}{2} = 1$，$|A| = \frac{3-(-1)}{2} = 2$。半个周期为 $6 - 2 = 4$，故 $T = 8$，$\omega = \frac{2\pi}{8} = \frac{\pi}{4}$。取 $A = 2$，由 $x = 2$ 处取最大值得 $\frac{\pi}{4}\times 2 + \varphi = \frac{\pi}{2}$，即 $\varphi = 0$。所以 $y = 2\sin\frac{\pi x}{4} + 1$。

expression.noteEn: Reading parameters from a graph: average gives $B$, peak difference gives $A$, period gives $\omega$, starting point gives $\varphi$.

fundamental-identities.definition:
**同角三角函数关系**指的是同一个角 $\alpha$ 的不同三角函数之间的恒等式。它们全部来自单位圆上 $x^2 + y^2 = 1$ 这一个事实，却足以把三个函数中的任意一个化归为另一个。

最基本的是**平方关系**：

$$\sin^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha = 1.$$

它在单位圆中就是勾股定理；两边同时除以 $\cos^2\alpha$ 得到 $1 + \tan^2\alpha = \sec^2\alpha$，除以 $\sin^2\alpha$ 得到 $1 + \cot^2\alpha = \csc^2\alpha$。

其次是**商数关系**：

$$\tan\alpha = \frac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha},\qquad \cot\alpha = \frac{\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha}.$$

以及**倒数关系** $\sec\alpha = \dfrac{1}{\cos\alpha}$、$\csc\alpha = \dfrac{1}{\sin\alpha}$、$\cot\alpha = \dfrac{1}{\tan\alpha}$。

这三组关系是「知一求二」的工具：只要知道一个角的某个三角函数值和它所在（或可能的）象限，就能求出其余全部函数值。做这类题时**先定象限判断符号，再用平方关系求绝对值**，是最稳妥的流程。
fundamental-identities.definitionEn:
The **fundamental identities** relate the different trigonometric functions of the same angle $\alpha$. All of them come from the single fact $x^2 + y^2 = 1$ on the unit circle, yet they are enough to convert any one of the functions into another.

The most basic is the **Pythagorean relation**:

$$\sin^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha = 1.$$

On the unit circle this is just Pythagoras' theorem. Dividing both sides by $\cos^2\alpha$ gives $1 + \tan^2\alpha = \sec^2\alpha$, and dividing by $\sin^2\alpha$ gives $1 + \cot^2\alpha = \csc^2\alpha$.

Next is the **quotient relation**:

$$\tan\alpha = \frac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha},\qquad \cot\alpha = \frac{\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha}.$$

Finally the **reciprocal relations**: $\sec\alpha = \dfrac{1}{\cos\alpha}$, $\csc\alpha = \dfrac{1}{\sin\alpha}$ and $\cot\alpha = \dfrac{1}{\tan\alpha}$.

Together these form a tool for finding all values from one: knowing a single trigonometric value of an angle and its quadrant, you can recover all the others. The reliable procedure is to **fix the quadrant to determine the signs, then use the Pythagorean relation for the magnitude**.

formulas.note: 平方关系，最核心的恒等式，由单位圆的 $x^2+y^2=1$ 得到
formulas.noteEn: The Pythagorean relation, the core identity, from $x^2+y^2=1$ on the unit circle

formulas.note: 商数关系，把正切化为正弦与余弦之比

examples.problem: 已知 $\tan\alpha = 2$，且 $\alpha$ 是第三象限角，求 $\sin\alpha$ 与 $\cos\alpha$。
examples.solution: 由 $\frac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha} = 2$ 得 $\sin\alpha = 2\cos\alpha$。代入平方关系：$4\cos^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha = 1$，即 $\cos^2\alpha = \frac{1}{5}$。第三象限中 $\cos\alpha < 0$，故 $\cos\alpha = -\frac{\sqrt{5}}{5}$，$\sin\alpha = -\frac{2\sqrt{5}}{5}$。

examples.problem: 化简 $\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{1-\cos\alpha} + \dfrac{1-\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha}$。
examples.solution: 通分得 $\frac{\sin^2\alpha + (1-\cos\alpha)^2}{\sin\alpha(1-\cos\alpha)} = \frac{\sin^2\alpha + 1 - 2\cos\alpha + \cos^2\alpha}{\sin\alpha(1-\cos\alpha)} = \frac{2 - 2\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha(1-\cos\alpha)} = \frac{2(1-\cos\alpha)}{\sin\alpha(1-\cos\alpha)} = \frac{2}{\sin\alpha}$。

reduction-formulas.definition:
**诱导公式**（也叫归约公式）是一组把任意角的三角函数值转化为某个锐角三角函数值的公式。有了它们，只需记住 $0$ 到 $\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ 之间的函数值，就能算出任何角的函数值。

它们可以按自变量分成四族：$-\alpha$、$\pi \pm \alpha$、$2\pi - \alpha$、以及最「别扭」的 $\dfrac{\pi}{2} \pm \alpha$ 和 $\dfrac{3\pi}{2} \pm \alpha$。前三族的函数名保持不变，第四族则会发生**名称互换**：正弦与余弦互换、正切与余切互换。

统一记忆口诀是：

> **奇变偶不变，符号看象限。**

这里的「$\frac{\pi}{2}$ 的奇数倍还是偶数倍」决定函数名是否改变：$\pi \pm \alpha$ 中的 $\pi$ 是 $\frac{\pi}{2}$ 的 2 倍（偶），函数名不变；$\frac{\pi}{2}\pm\alpha$ 中系数是 1（奇），函数名要变。而「符号看象限」指的是：**把 $\alpha$ 当成锐角**，判断原角落在哪个象限，该象限中原函数的正负就是结果的正负。

本质上看，诱导公式就是单位圆的**对称性**：$-\alpha$ 关于 $x$ 轴对称，$\pi-\alpha$ 关于 $y$ 轴对称，$\pi+\alpha$ 关于原点对称，$\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha$ 关于直线 $y=x$ 对称。
reduction-formulas.definitionEn:
The **reduction formulas** convert the trigonometric value of any angle into that of an acute angle. With them, memorising the values on $\left[0, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]$ is enough to evaluate any angle at all.

They fall into four families by argument: $-\alpha$, $\pi \pm \alpha$, $2\pi - \alpha$, and the trickier $\dfrac{\pi}{2} \pm \alpha$ and $\dfrac{3\pi}{2} \pm \alpha$. The first three keep the function name; the last family **swaps names**: sine with cosine, tangent with cotangent.

The standard mnemonic is:

> **Odd changes, even keeps; the sign follows the quadrant.**

Whether the coefficient of $\frac{\pi}{2}$ is odd or even decides whether the name changes: in $\pi \pm \alpha$ the $\pi$ is twice $\frac{\pi}{2}$ (even), so the name is preserved; in $\frac{\pi}{2}\pm\alpha$ the coefficient is 1 (odd), so the name changes. The sign is found by **pretending $\alpha$ is acute** and asking which quadrant the original angle lies in — the sign of the original function there is the sign of the result.

Geometrically these are just the **symmetries of the unit circle**: $-\alpha$ reflects in the x-axis, $\pi-\alpha$ in the y-axis, $\pi+\alpha$ in the origin, and $\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha$ in the line $y=x$.

formulas.note: $\pi-\alpha$ 族，函数名不变，只改符号

The $\frac{\pi}{2} - \alpha$ rule is simply complementarity: $\sin\theta = \cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta\right)$

examples.problem: 求 $\sin\dfrac{7\pi}{6}$ 与 $\cos\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$ 的值。
examples.solution: $\sin\frac{7\pi}{6} = \sin\left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = -\sin\frac{\pi}{6} = -\frac{1}{2}$；$\cos\frac{5\pi}{4} = \cos\left(\pi + \frac{\pi}{4}\right) = -\cos\frac{\pi}{4} = -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$。

examples.problem: 化简 $\dfrac{\sin(\pi-\alpha)\cos(2\pi-\alpha)}{\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\alpha\right)\sin(-\alpha)}$。
examples.solution: $\sin(\pi-\alpha) = \sin\alpha$，$\cos(2\pi-\alpha) = \cos\alpha$，$\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\alpha\right) = -\sin\alpha$，$\sin(-\alpha) = -\sin\alpha$。代入得 $\frac{\sin\alpha\cos\alpha}{(-\sin\alpha)(-\sin\alpha)} = \frac{\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha} = \cot\alpha$。

expression.noteEn: First reduce the angle into $[0, 2\pi)$ by periodicity, then use the formulas to reach an acute angle.

trigonometric-identities.definition:
**三角恒等变换**研究如何把一个三角函数式变形为另一个在数学上等价但形式更简单的式子。核心公式是**和差角公式**，其余大部分公式都由它推出。

和差角公式说：正弦的加法里正弦与余弦「交叉」，余弦的加法里出现减号：

$$\sin(\alpha \pm \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta \pm \cos\alpha\sin\beta,$$

$$\cos(\alpha \pm \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta \mp \sin\alpha\sin\beta.$$

正切的和角公式由它们相除得到，注意 $\cos\alpha\cos\beta \neq 0$ 且分母不为零。

令 $\beta = \alpha$ 就得到**二倍角公式**：$\sin 2\alpha = 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha$、$\cos 2\alpha = \cos^2\alpha - \sin^2\alpha = 1 - 2\sin^2\alpha = 2\cos^2\alpha - 1$。余弦的三种写法极其有用，因为它们能把二次式降次，是积分与解方程中的常用手段。

把二倍角公式反用，得到**降幂公式** $\sin^2\alpha = \dfrac{1-\cos 2\alpha}{2}$、$\cos^2\alpha = \dfrac{1+\cos 2\alpha}{2}$；再把 $\alpha$ 换成 $\dfrac{\alpha}{2}$ 就得到半角公式。

最后是**辅助角公式**：把 $a\sin x + b\cos x$（$a,b$ 不同时为零）合并成一个正弦，其中 $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$ 是振幅，$\varphi$ 由 $\sin\varphi=\dfrac{b}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$、$\cos\varphi=\dfrac{a}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$ 确定（只写 $\tan\varphi=\dfrac{b}{a}$ 不够，辐角可差 $\pi$ 使整体变号）。这是求三角函数最值与周期的利器。
trigonometric-identities.definitionEn:
**Trigonometric transformations** study how to rewrite a trigonometric expression into an equivalent but simpler form. The key formulas are the **sum and difference formulas**, from which most of the rest follow.

In the sum formulas the sine «crosses» sine with cosine, while the cosine formula carries a minus sign:

$$\sin(\alpha \pm \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta \pm \cos\alpha\sin\beta,$$

$$\cos(\alpha \pm \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta \mp \sin\alpha\sin\beta.$$

The tangent sum formula follows by dividing them, provided $\cos\alpha\cos\beta \neq 0$ and the denominator is non-zero.

Setting $\beta = \alpha$ gives the **double-angle formulas**: $\sin 2\alpha = 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha$ and $\cos 2\alpha = \cos^2\alpha - \sin^2\alpha = 1 - 2\sin^2\alpha = 2\cos^2\alpha - 1$. The three forms of the cosine are especially useful because they reduce a square to a linear term, a staple in integration and in solving equations.

Running the double-angle formulas backwards gives the **power-reduction formulas** $\sin^2\alpha = \dfrac{1-\cos 2\alpha}{2}$ and $\cos^2\alpha = \dfrac{1+\cos 2\alpha}{2}$; replacing $\alpha$ by $\dfrac{\alpha}{2}$ then yields the half-angle formulas.

Finally the **auxiliary-angle formula** merges $a\sin x + b\cos x$ (with $a,b$ not both zero) into one sine, with amplitude $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$ and $\varphi$ fixed by $\sin\varphi=\dfrac{b}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$, $\cos\varphi=\dfrac{a}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$ (the single equation $\tan\varphi=b/a$ would not pin down $\varphi$, which may differ by $\pi$ and flip the sign). It is the sharpest tool for finding extrema and periods of trigonometric expressions.

formulas.note: 降幂公式，把平方化为一次式

examples.problem: 求 $\sin 75^\circ$ 的精确值。
examples.solution: $\sin 75^\circ = \sin(45^\circ + 30^\circ) = \sin 45^\circ\cos 30^\circ + \cos 45^\circ\sin 30^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cdot\frac{1}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{6}+\sqrt{2}}{4}$。

examples.problem: 已知 $\sin\alpha = \frac{3}{5}$，$\alpha \in \left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right)$，求 $\sin 2\alpha$ 与 $\cos 2\alpha$。
examples.solution: 由 $\alpha$ 在第二象限得 $\cos\alpha = -\sqrt{1-\frac{9}{25}} = -\frac{4}{5}$。于是 $\sin 2\alpha = 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha = 2\times\frac{3}{5}\times\left(-\frac{4}{5}\right) = -\frac{24}{25}$；$\cos 2\alpha = 1 - 2\sin^2\alpha = 1 - \frac{18}{25} = \frac{7}{25}$。

examples.problem: 求函数 $y = \sin x + \sqrt{3}\cos x$ 的最大值与最小正周期。
examples.solution: 由辅助角公式，$y = \sqrt{1+3}\,\sin\left(x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right) = 2\sin\left(x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)$，其中 $\tan\varphi = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{1}$ 取 $\varphi = \frac{\pi}{3}$。故最大值为 $2$，最小值 $-2$，最小正周期 $T = 2\pi$。

expression.text: a sin x + b cos x = √(a²+b²) sin(x+φ)

trig-properties.definition:
**三角函数的性质**指的是正弦、余弦、正切函数在定义域上表现出的整体特征，主要包括周期性、奇偶性、单调性、对称性和最值。掌握这些性质，就能不画图而直接判断函数的走势。

**周期性**是最本质的特征。若存在非零常数 $T$ 使 $f(x+T) = f(x)$ 对定义域内一切 $x$ 成立，则称 $f$ 为周期函数，$T$ 为它的周期，其中最小的正数叫**最小正周期**。$\sin$ 与 $\cos$ 的最小正周期都是 $2\pi$，$\tan$ 的是 $\pi$。对复合函数 $y = A\sin(\omega x + \varphi) + B$，最小正周期为 $\dfrac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$。

**奇偶性**上，$\sin$ 是奇函数（关于原点对称），$\cos$ 是偶函数（关于 $y$ 轴对称），$\tan$ 也是奇函数。它们共同的一点是图像具有**平移对称性与反射对称性**：正弦图像关于直线 $x = \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi$ 轴对称，同时关于点 $(k\pi, 0)$ 中心对称。

**单调性**需要在同一个单调区间内讨论。特别注意：$\tan$ 在每个小区间 $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi, \frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi\right)$ 上是增函数，但在整个定义域上**不是**增函数——这是最容易被忽视的陷阱。

研究一般三角函数的流程通常是：先用恒等变换把它化为 $y = A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+B$ 的标准形，再由标准形读出周期、最值、单调区间和对称轴。
trig-properties.definitionEn:
The **properties of trigonometric functions** are the overall features that sine, cosine and tangent exhibit on their domains: periodicity, parity, monotonicity, symmetry and extrema. Knowing them lets you read the behaviour of a graph without drawing it.

**Periodicity** is the essential feature. If a non-zero constant $T$ satisfies $f(x+T) = f(x)$ for all $x$, then $f$ is periodic and $T$ is a period; the smallest positive one is the **least positive period**. The sine and cosine both have least positive period $2\pi$, the tangent $\pi$. For a composite $y = A\sin(\omega x + \varphi) + B$ the least positive period is $\dfrac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$.

As for **parity**, $\sin$ is odd (symmetric about the origin), $\cos$ is even (symmetric about the y-axis) and $\tan$ is also odd. What they share is **reflective and central symmetry**: the sine graph has axes of symmetry $x = \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi$ and centres of symmetry $(k\pi, 0)$.

**Monotonicity** must be discussed inside a single monotonic interval. In particular, $\tan$ increases on each interval $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi, \frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi\right)$ but is **not** increasing on its entire domain — the most commonly missed trap.

The usual workflow for studying a general trigonometric function is: first reduce it to the standard form $y = A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+B$ by identities, then read off the period, the extrema, the monotonic intervals and the axes of symmetry.

formulas.noteEn: Periods of the three basic functions: $2\pi$, $2\pi$ and $\pi$

examples.problem: 求函数 $y = 2\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{3} - 2x\right)$ 的周期、单调递增区间。
examples.solution: 先化简为 $y = -2\sin\left(2x - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$（利用 $-\alpha$ 的诱导公式），周期 $T = \frac{2\pi}{2} = \pi$。$y$ 递增当且仅当 $\sin\left(2x-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)$ 递减，即 $\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi \leq 2x-\frac{\pi}{3} \leq \frac{3\pi}{2}+2k\pi$，解得 $\frac{5\pi}{12}+k\pi \leq x \leq \frac{11\pi}{12}+k\pi$。

examples.problem: 已知函数 $f(x) = \sin(\omega x)$（$\omega > 0$）的最小正周期为 $\frac{\pi}{2}$，求 $\omega$，并写出它的一条对称轴。
examples.solution: 由 $\frac{2\pi}{\omega} = \frac{\pi}{2}$ 得 $\omega = 4$，即 $f(x) = \sin 4x$。对称轴由 $4x = \frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi$ 得 $x = \frac{\pi}{8} + \frac{k\pi}{4}$，取 $k=0$ 得一条对称轴 $x = \frac{\pi}{8}$。

expression.noteEn: Every property can be read off the standard form $y = A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+B$ at once.

law-of-sines.definition:
在任意三角形 $ABC$ 中，设角 $A,B,C$ 的对边分别为 $a,b,c$，外接圆半径为 $R$，则三条边与它们对角的正弦之比恒相等：

$$\frac{a}{\sin A} = \frac{b}{\sin B} = \frac{c}{\sin C} = 2R$$

这就是**正弦定理**。它揭示了三角形的边角关系：大边对大角，边与对角正弦成**正比**。

它的重要性在于——只要知道两角一边，或两边及其中一边的对角，就能把整个三角形「解」出来。它也是把几何长度问题转化为三角函数问题的第一把钥匙，在天文测距、地图测绘和物理的矢量分解中反复出现。
law-of-sines.definitionEn:
In any triangle $ABC$, let $a,b,c$ be the sides opposite to angles $A,B,C$ and let $R$ be the circumradius. Then the ratio of each side to the sine of its opposite angle is constant:

$$\frac{a}{\sin A} = \frac{b}{\sin B} = \frac{c}{\sin C} = 2R$$

This is the **law of sines**. It expresses the fact that larger sides face larger angles — sides are proportional to the sines of their opposite angles.

Its power is that knowing two angles and one side, or two sides and a non-included angle, allows you to solve the whole triangle. It is the first key that converts length problems in geometry into trigonometric ones, and it reappears in astronomy, surveying and vector decomposition.

formulas.note: 正弦定理的核心形式：三组边角比相等，用来由已知边角求未知边角。
formulas.noteEn: The core form: the three side-to-sine ratios are equal, used to find unknown sides or angles.

formulas.note: 比值等于外接圆直径 $2R$，该式可反求外接圆半径 $R = \dfrac{a}{2\sin A}$。
formulas.noteEn: The common ratio equals the circumdiameter $2R$, so $R = \dfrac{a}{2\sin A}$.

formulas.noteEn: Sides are proportional to the sines of opposite angles, useful for converting between sides and angles.

formulas.note: 由正弦定理导出的面积公式，已知两边及其夹角时最方便。
formulas.noteEn: Area formula derived with the law of sines; best when two sides and the included angle are known.

比值等于外接圆直径 $2R$，联系了三角形的边角与外界圆

examples.problem: 在 $\triangle ABC$ 中，已知 $a = 4$，$A = 30^{\circ}$，$B = 45^{\circ}$，求边 $b$ 与外接圆半径 $R$。
examples.solution: 由正弦定理 $\dfrac{a}{\sin A} = \dfrac{b}{\sin B}$，得 $b = \dfrac{a\sin B}{\sin A} = \dfrac{4 \times \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}{\frac{1}{2}} = 4\sqrt{2}$。再由 $\dfrac{a}{\sin A} = 2R$，得 $R = \dfrac{a}{2\sin A} = \dfrac{4}{2 \times \frac{1}{2}} = 4$。所以 $b = 4\sqrt{2}$，$R = 4$。

expression.text: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C = 2R
expression.note: 适用于任意三角形，包括锐角、直角和钝角三角形。
expression.noteEn: Valid for every triangle — acute, right or obtuse.

law-of-cosines.definition:
在任意三角形 $ABC$ 中，角 $A,B,C$ 的对边分别为 $a,b,c$，则

$$a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc\cos A$$

同理可得关于 $b,c$ 的对称形式。这条规律叫**余弦定理**。

它其实是勾股定理在一般三角形上的推广：把上式移项得 $a^2 - b^2 - c^2 = -2bc\cos A$。当 $A = 90^{\circ}$ 时 $\cos A = 0$，公式就退化为熟悉的 $a^2 = b^2 + c^2$。因此余弦定理可以看作是描述「勾股定理的偏差」：夹角越大，对角边越长。

它最擅长处理「两边夹一角」和「三边求角」两类问题，是解三角形时与正弦定理并用的另一件主要工具。
law-of-cosines.definitionEn:
In any triangle $ABC$ with opposite sides $a,b,c$,

$$a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc\cos A$$

and similarly for the other two sides. This is the **law of cosines**.

It generalises the Pythagorean theorem: rearranged, it reads $a^2 - b^2 - c^2 = -2bc\cos A$. When $A = 90^{\circ}$ we have $\cos A = 0$ and it collapses to $a^2 = b^2 + c^2$. So the law of cosines measures the deviation from a right angle — the larger the included angle, the longer the opposite side.

It handles two problems best: two sides with the included angle, and three sides given. Together with the law of sines it is the main tool for solving triangles.

formulas.note: 余弦定理基本形式：已知两边及夹角求第三边。
formulas.noteEn: Basic form: find the third side from two sides and the included angle.

formulas.note: 变形形式：已知三边求角，也可用来判断三角形的形状。
formulas.noteEn: Rearranged form: find an angle from three sides, or classify the triangle.

formulas.noteEn: Determine acuteness from squared sides: $\cos A > 0$ means acute, $\cos A < 0$ means obtuse.

examples.problem: 在 $\triangle ABC$ 中，$b = 3$，$c = 4$，$A = 60^{\circ}$，求 $a$。
examples.solution: 由余弦定理 $a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc\cos A = 9 + 16 - 2 \times 3 \times 4 \times \frac{1}{2} = 25 - 12 = 13$，所以 $a = \sqrt{13}$。

examples.problem: 已知 $\triangle ABC$ 三边为 $a = 7$，$b = 5$，$c = 3$，判断它的形状最大角的度数。
examples.solution: 最大角对应最大边 $a = 7$，用变形公式 $\cos A = \dfrac{b^2 + c^2 - a^2}{2bc} = \dfrac{25 + 9 - 49}{2 \times 5 \times 3} = \dfrac{-15}{30} = -\dfrac{1}{2}$。因为 $\cos A < 0$，所以 $A = 120^{\circ}$，该三角形为钝角三角形。

expression.note: 三个角各有一条对称公式，$bc$ 是夹角的邻边乘积。
expression.noteEn: There is one symmetric formula for each angle; $bc$ is the product of the sides adjacent to the angle.

triangle-area.definition:
三角形的**面积**度量它所占的平面区域大小。最朴素的定义是「底乘高除以二」：$S = \dfrac{1}{2} \times \text{底} \times \text{高}$。

在解三角形中更有用的是**两边夹一角公式**：

$$S = \frac{1}{2}ab\sin C$$

它把面积与三角形的边角数据直接联系起来，由它配合正弦定理可导出 $S = \dfrac{abc}{4R}$，配合海伦公式又可得到只用三边表示的形式。

面积公式是几何与三角之间的桥梁：许多「求面积」的题目实际是在考如何把已知条件转成边角关系，再套用合适的公式。
triangle-area.definitionEn:
The **area** of a triangle measures the plane region it encloses. The most basic definition is half the base times the height: $S = \dfrac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height}$.

More useful in solving triangles is the **two-sides-and-included-angle** formula:

$$S = \frac{1}{2}ab\sin C$$

It links area directly to side-angle data. Combined with the law of sines it yields $S = \dfrac{abc}{4R}$, and with Heron's formula it becomes an expression in the three sides alone.

Area formulas are the bridge between geometry and trigonometry: many area problems are really about converting given data into side-angle relations and choosing the right formula.

formulas.note: 底乘高除以二，$h_a$ 为 $a$ 边上的高，是最基本的面积公式。
formulas.noteEn: Half base times height, with $h_a$ the height on side $a$; the most basic formula.

formulas.note: 已知两边及其夹角求面积，是解三角形中最常用的面积公式。
formulas.noteEn: Area from two sides and the included angle; the workhorse formula in solving triangles.

formulas.note: 用三边和外接圆半径表示面积，由正弦定理代入面积公式得到。
formulas.noteEn: Area in terms of three sides and the circumradius, obtained by substituting the law of sines.

formulas.note: 海伦公式（$p$ 为半周长），仅用三边即可求面积。
formulas.noteEn: Heron's formula with semiperimeter $p$; uses only the three sides.

formulas.note: $r$ 为内切圆半径，$p$ 为半周长，常用于已知面积的逆问题。
formulas.noteEn: With inradius $r$ and semiperimeter $p$; useful for inverse problems.

properties: 两边夹一角公式 $S = \frac{1}{2}ab\sin C$ 中角的正弦恒为正，结果总为正
面积随夹角增大而增大：两边固定时，$C = 90^{\circ}$ 取得最大面积 $\frac{1}{2}ab$
同一三角形用不同边角组合计算面积结果相同，可用于检验解法
海伦公式说明三边一旦确定，面积随之唯一确定（SSS 全等）
面积与内切圆、外接圆半径通过 $S = pr = \dfrac{abc}{4R}$ 建立联系
propertiesEn: In $S = \frac{1}{2}ab\sin C$ the sine of the angle is always positive, so the area is positive
Area grows with the included angle; for fixed sides it is largest, $\frac{1}{2}ab$, at $C = 90^{\circ}$
Any valid combination of sides and angles gives the same area, which checks a solution
Heron's formula shows three sides determine the area uniquely (SSS congruence)
Area connects to the inradius and circumradius via $S = pr = \dfrac{abc}{4R}$

examples.problem: 在 $\triangle ABC$ 中，$a = 5$，$b = 8$，$C = 30^{\circ}$，求三角形的面积。
examples.solution: 由面积公式 $S = \dfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C = \dfrac{1}{2} \times 5 \times 8 \times \sin 30^{\circ} = 20 \times \dfrac{1}{2} = 10$。所以面积为 $10$。

expression.note: 夹角必须是所取两边之间的角，$C$ 是 $a$、$b$ 的夹角。
expression.noteEn: The angle must lie between the chosen sides: $C$ is the angle between $a$ and $b$.

triangle-application.definition:
**解三角形的实际应用**指的是：把现实中的测距、测高、测角问题抽象成一个（或几个）三角形，再用正弦定理、余弦定理和面积公式算出未知量。

关键在于「翻译」：把文字描述中的方位、仰角、俯角、坡度等术语画成带标注的三角形。常用的术语有：**仰角**（视线在水平线上方时与水平线的夹角）、**俯角**（视线在水平线下方时的夹角）、**方位角**（从正北方向顺时针旋转到目标方向的角度）、**坡角**（斜面与水平面的夹角）。

由于大多数情形不能直接测量，需要构造两个或多个三角形，通过公共边把已知量传递过去。这类问题在测绘、航海、航空、天文和建筑工程中随处可见，是把三角学从课本带进现实的核心场景。
triangle-application.definitionEn:
**Applications of solving triangles** means abstracting real-world problems about distances, heights and angles into one or more triangles, then computing unknown quantities with the laws of sines and cosines and area formulas.

The key skill is translation: turning wording about direction, elevation, depression and slope into an annotated triangle. Standard terms include the **angle of elevation** (above the horizontal), the **angle of depression** (below the horizontal), the **bearing** (measured clockwise from north) and the **slope angle** (between a slope and the horizontal).

Since most quantities cannot be measured directly, one constructs two or more triangles and passes known values through a shared side. Such problems appear throughout surveying, navigation, aviation, astronomy and civil engineering — the main route from textbook trigonometry into the real world.

formulas.note: 正弦定理：适用于已知两角一边或两边一对角的测量三角形。
formulas.noteEn: Law of sines: for two angles and a side, or two sides and a non-included angle.

formulas.note: 余弦定理：适用于已知两边及夹角（如两次测距加方位角差）的场景。
formulas.noteEn: Law of cosines: for two measured sides and the angle between them.

formulas.note: 已知水平距离 $d$ 和仰角 $\alpha$，求竖直高度 $h$，是最简单的测高模型。
formulas.noteEn: Height $h$ from horizontal distance $d$ and elevation angle $\alpha$; the simplest height model.

formulas.note: 在两点测同一目标的仰角 $\alpha,\beta$，两点相距 $d$，可消去到目标的水平距离求出高度。
formulas.noteEn: Given elevation angles $\alpha,\beta$ from two points a distance $d$ apart, the unknown horizontal distance cancels.

properties: 解题第一步永远是画图，把仰角、俯角、方位角标在图上
实际量必须有实际意义：求出的边长、角度要为正且满足三角形内角和为 $180^{\circ}$
多个三角形通过公共边（或公共角）联系起来，是测量题的基本结构
已知「两边一对角」时要检验是否出现两解，再结合实际图形取舍
近似计算中注意单位统一与有效数字，测量误差会沿计算链条放大
propertiesEn: Always draw the diagram first, marking elevation, depression and bearing angles
Answers must be physically meaningful: positive lengths and angles summing to $180^{\circ}$
Shared sides or angles link several triangles — the standard structure of surveying problems
Check for the ambiguous two-solution case with two sides and a non-included angle, then use the figure to decide
Keep units consistent and track significant figures; measurement error propagates through the chain

examples.problem: 要测量河对岸的点 $C$ 到岸边点 $D$ 的距离。在岸上选一点 $A$（与 $D$ 同侧），测得 $AD=100\text{ m}$，$\angle CAD=60^{\circ}$，$\angle ADC=75^{\circ}$，求 $CD$（用正弦定理）。
examples.solution: 在 $\triangle ACD$ 中，$\angle ACD = 180^{\circ} - 60^{\circ} - 75^{\circ} = 45^{\circ}$。由正弦定理 $\dfrac{CD}{\sin 60^{\circ}} = \dfrac{AD}{\sin 45^{\circ}}$，得 $CD = \dfrac{100 \sin 60^{\circ}}{\sin 45^{\circ}} = \dfrac{100 \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}} = 50\sqrt{6} \approx 122.5\text{ m}$。

examples.problem: 在距塔底水平距离 $60\text{ m}$ 处测得塔顶仰角为 $30^{\circ}$，求塔高。
examples.solution: 设塔高为 $h$，水平距离 $d = 60$，仰角 $\alpha = 30^{\circ}$。由 $h = d\tan\alpha = 60 \times \tan 30^{\circ} = 60 \times \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{3} = 20\sqrt{3} \approx 34.6\text{ m}$。所以塔高约为 $34.6\text{ m}$。

inverse-trig-functions.definition:
三角函数是周期函数，并不单调，因此整体上不可逆。为了让反函数存在，我们给每个三角函数选定一段**单调区间**并限制值域，这样就得到**反三角函数**：

- **反正弦** $y = \arcsin x$：定义域 $[-1, 1]$，值域 $\left[-\dfrac{\pi}{2}, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]$；
- **反余弦** $y = \arccos x$：定义域 $[-1, 1]$，值域 $[0, \pi]$；
- **反正切** $y = \arctan x$：定义域 $\mathbb{R}$，值域 $\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{2}, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$。

每个反三角函数都是对应三角函数在该区间上的反函数，图像关于直线 $y = x$ 与限制后的原函数图像对称。它们在工程与物理中用途极广：凡是需要「由比值求角度」的场合（求相位、求倾角、求方位）都要用到它们。

formulas.latex: y = \arcsin x \iff \sin y = x,\ -1\le x\le 1,\ y\in\left[-\tfrac{\pi}{2}, \tfrac{\pi}{2}\right]
formulas.note: 反正弦的定义：由正弦值求角，值域限制保证了唯一性。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of arcsine: recover an angle from a sine value; the restricted range ensures uniqueness.

formulas.latex: y = \arccos x \iff \cos y = x,\ -1\le x\le 1,\ y\in[0, \pi]
formulas.note: 反余弦的定义：值域为 $[0,\pi]$，因此 $\arccos x$ 的符号恒定非负。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of arccosine with range $[0,\pi]$, so $\arccos x$ is never negative.

formulas.latex: y = \arctan x \iff \tan y = x,\ x\in\mathbb{R},\ y\in\left(-\tfrac{\pi}{2}, \tfrac{\pi}{2}\right)
formulas.note: 反正切的定义：定义域为全体实数，常用于求相位角。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of arctangent; the domain is all reals and it is often used for phase angles.

formulas.note: 奇偶与互补关系：$\arcsin$ 是奇函数，$\arccos$ 满足互补恒等式。
formulas.noteEn: Parity and cofunction relations: $\arcsin$ is odd, while $\arccos$ satisfies a supplementary identity.

formulas.note: 重要恒等式，对任意 $x \in [-1, 1]$ 成立。
formulas.noteEn: Fundamental identity valid for every $x \in [-1, 1]$.

properties: $\arcsin x$ 与 $\arctan x$ 是奇函数，$\arccos x$ 既非奇也非偶
三个反三角函数的图像都关于直线 $y = x$ 与限制区间上的原函数对称
$\arcsin x$、$\arccos x$ 的定义域是 $[-1, 1]$，$\arctan x$ 的定义域是 $\mathbb{R}$
$\arctan x$ 有两条水平渐近线 $y = \pm\dfrac{\pi}{2}$，且 $\arctan x + \arctan \dfrac{1}{x} = \pm\dfrac{\pi}{2}$（$x>0$ 取正）
反三角函数值域受限，所以同一三角函数值只对应一个「主值」角度
propertiesEn: $\arcsin x$ and $\arctan x$ are odd; $\arccos x$ is neither odd nor even
Each graph is the reflection of the restricted trigonometric graph in the line $y = x$
$\arcsin x$ and $\arccos x$ have domain $[-1, 1]$; $\arctan x$ has domain $\mathbb{R}$
$\arctan x$ has horizontal asymptotes $y = \pm\dfrac{\pi}{2}$
The restricted ranges mean each trigonometric value corresponds to exactly one principal angle

examples.problem: 计算 $\arcsin\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \arccos\dfrac{1}{2}$ 的值。
examples.solution: 因为 $\sin\dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$ 且 $\dfrac{\pi}{3} \in \left[-\dfrac{\pi}{2}, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]$，所以 $\arcsin\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \dfrac{\pi}{3}$。同理 $\cos\dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{1}{2}$ 且 $\dfrac{\pi}{3} \in [0, \pi]$，故 $\arccos\dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{\pi}{3}$。因此原式 $= \dfrac{\pi}{3} + \dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{2\pi}{3}$。

examples.problem: 求 $\sin\left(\arccos\dfrac{3}{5}\right)$ 的值。
examples.solution: 设 $\theta = \arccos\dfrac{3}{5}$，则 $\cos\theta = \dfrac{3}{5}$，且 $\theta \in [0, \pi]$，所以 $\sin\theta \ge 0$。由 $\sin^2\theta = 1 - \cos^2\theta = 1 - \dfrac{9}{25} = \dfrac{16}{25}$，得 $\sin\theta = \dfrac{4}{5}$。因此 $\sin\left(\arccos\dfrac{3}{5}\right) = \dfrac{4}{5}$。

expression.note: 注意：$\arcsin(\sin x)$ 不一定等于 $x$，只有当 $x$ 落在限制值域内才成立。
expression.noteEn: Caution: $\arcsin(\sin x)$ need not equal $x$ unless $x$ lies in the restricted range.

auxiliary-angle.definition:
形如 $a\sin x + b\cos x$ 的式子看起来是两个不同频率的三角函数的和，但由于它们频率相同，实际上仍是一个正弦型函数。**辅助角公式**把它合并成：

$$a\sin x + b\cos x = \sqrt{a^2+b^2}\,\sin(x + \varphi)$$

其中辅助角 $\varphi$ 满足 $\cos\varphi = \dfrac{a}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$，$\sin\varphi = \dfrac{b}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$，即 $\tan\varphi = \dfrac{b}{a}$。

这个技巧的价值在于「降维」：把振幅、周期、最值、单调性这些问题的研究对象，从两个函数的和变成一个标准正弦函数。它是求三角函数最值、化解三角方程以及物理中同频简谐振动合成的标准武器。
auxiliary-angle.definitionEn:
An expression $a\sin x + b\cos x$ looks like a sum of two trigonometric terms, but since they share the same frequency it is still a single sine wave. The **auxiliary angle formula** merges it as

$$a\sin x + b\cos x = \sqrt{a^2+b^2}\,\sin(x + \varphi)$$

where the auxiliary angle $\varphi$ satisfies $\cos\varphi = \dfrac{a}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$ and $\sin\varphi = \dfrac{b}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$, equivalently $\tan\varphi = \dfrac{b}{a}$.

The trick reduces two functions to one standard sine wave, so questions about amplitude, period, extrema and monotonicity can all be answered at once. It is the standard weapon for minimising trigonometric expressions, simplifying equations, and superposing same-frequency harmonic oscillations in physics.

formulas.note: 辅助角公式的一般形式，$\varphi$ 为辅助角，振幅为 $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$。
formulas.noteEn: General form with auxiliary angle $\varphi$ and amplitude $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$.

formulas.note: 辅助角的确定方式，同时需结合 $a$ 与 $b$ 的符号判断 $\varphi$ 所在象限。
formulas.noteEn: Determines the auxiliary angle; use the signs of $a$ and $b$ to fix its quadrant.

formulas.note: 最常见的特例（$a = b = 1$），$\varphi = \dfrac{\pi}{4}$。
formulas.noteEn: The most common special case ($a = b = 1$) with $\varphi = \dfrac{\pi}{4}$.

formulas.note: 另一典型特例，说明 $b$ 为负时辅助角为负。
formulas.noteEn: Another typical case showing that a negative $b$ gives a negative auxiliary angle.

formulas.note: 由合并式直接得到的最值结论，值域为 $[-R, R]$。
formulas.noteEn: The extrema read off directly from the merged form; range $[-R, R]$.

properties: 合并后仍是周期为 $2\pi$ 的正弦型函数，振幅为 $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$
值域为 $\left[-\sqrt{a^2+b^2},\ \sqrt{a^2+b^2}\right]$，最大值与最小值在 $x+\varphi = \pm\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ 处取得
辅助角 $\varphi$ 与 $a,b$ 的符号有关，必须写在正确的象限里
$a=0$ 或 $b=0$ 时公式退化为单一三角函数，仍然成立
可推广为 $a\sin x + b\cos x = \sqrt{a^2+b^2}\cos(x-\theta)$ 的余弦形式
propertiesEn: The result is a sine wave of period $2\pi$ with amplitude $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$
Its range is $\left[-\sqrt{a^2+b^2},\ \sqrt{a^2+b^2}\right]$, attained when $x+\varphi = \pm\dfrac{\pi}{2}$
The auxiliary angle depends on the signs of $a$ and $b$ and must sit in the correct quadrant
If $a=0$ or $b=0$ it reduces to a single trigonometric term and still holds
It generalises to a cosine form $a\sin x + b\cos x = \sqrt{a^2+b^2}\cos(x-\theta)$

examples.problem: 求函数 $f(x) = \sqrt{3}\sin x + \cos x$ 的最大值及取最大值时的 $x$。
examples.solution: 由辅助角公式，$R = \sqrt{(\sqrt{3})^2 + 1^2} = 2$，且 $\tan\varphi = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$，取 $\varphi = \dfrac{\pi}{6}$，故 $f(x) = 2\sin\left(x + \dfrac{\pi}{6}\right)$。因此最大值为 $2$，当 $x + \dfrac{\pi}{6} = \dfrac{\pi}{2} + 2k\pi$，即 $x = \dfrac{\pi}{3} + 2k\pi\ (k\in\mathbb{Z})$ 时取得。

expression.text: a·sin x + b·cos x = R·sin(x + φ),  R = √(a²+b²)
expression.note: 要求 $a,b$ 不同时为零；$\varphi$ 由 $\tan\varphi = b/a$ 及符号共同确定。
expression.noteEn: Requires $a,b$ not both zero; $\varphi$ is fixed by $\tan\varphi = b/a$ together with the signs.

sinusoidal-model.definition:
**正弦型函数**具有一般形式

$$y = A\sin(\omega x + \varphi) + k$$

其中 $A$ 叫**振幅**，决定波峰到平衡位置的高度；$\omega$ 是**角频率**，决定周期 $T = \dfrac{2\pi}{\omega}$；$\varphi$ 是**初相**，决定图像左右平移；$k$ 是**纵向位移**，决定平衡位置的高度。

现实世界中大量现象是周期性的：单摆摆动、弹簧振动、交流电电压、声波、潮汐、气温年变化等，都可以用正弦型函数近似描述。这就是它作为**数学模型**的价值——只要测出振幅、周期和相位，就能预言未来任一时刻的状态，也能把不同来源的波动进行叠加分析。

确定这些参数的过程叫「拟合」：通常从最大值和最小值定 $A$ 与 $k$，从相邻两个零点或最值点的间距定周期，再代入一个已知点定 $\varphi$。
sinusoidal-model.definitionEn:
A **sinusoidal function** has the general form

$$y = A\sin(\omega x + \varphi) + k$$

Here $A$ is the **amplitude** (half the peak-to-trough height), $\omega$ is the **angular frequency** so that the period is $T = \dfrac{2\pi}{\omega}$, $\varphi$ is the **phase shift** controlling horizontal translation, and $k$ is the vertical shift giving the equilibrium level.

Countless real phenomena are periodic: pendulums, springs, alternating-current voltages, sound waves, tides and seasonal temperature. A sinusoidal function approximates them all — that is its value as a **mathematical model**: measure amplitude, period and phase once, and you can predict the state at any future time or superpose several waves.

Fitting the parameters is routine: read $A$ and $k$ from the maximum and minimum, read the period from the spacing of two adjacent zeros or extrema, then substitute one known point to fix $\varphi$.

formulas.note: 正弦型函数的一般式，四个参数各司其职。
formulas.noteEn: The general sinusoidal form; four parameters, four distinct roles.

formulas.note: 周期公式，$\omega$ 越大周期越短，波越密。
formulas.noteEn: Period formula: larger $\omega$ means a shorter period and a denser wave.

formulas.note: 由最大值和最小值反求振幅与纵向位移。
formulas.noteEn: Recover amplitude and vertical shift from the maximum and minimum.

formulas.note: 由周期求角频率；若图像在 $x_0$ 处从平衡位置上升，可由此定初相。
formulas.noteEn: Get $\omega$ from the period; if the graph rises through equilibrium at $x_0$, this fixes the phase.

properties: 值域为 $[k-|A|,\ k+|A|]$，最大值 $A+k$，最小值 $-A+k$
周期为 $T = \dfrac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$，与振幅无关
图像可由 $y = \sin x$ 经纵向伸缩、横向伸缩和平移复合得到
初相 $\varphi$ 只改变左右位置，不影响形状；可用「五点法」快速作图
多个同频正弦型函数叠加后仍是正弦型函数，可由辅助角公式合并
propertiesEn: Range is $[k-|A|,\ k+|A|]$ with maximum $A+k$ and minimum $-A+k$
The period is $T = \dfrac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$, independent of the amplitude
The graph is built from $y = \sin x$ by vertical and horizontal scaling plus translations
The phase only shifts the graph horizontally; use the five-point method to sketch it
Summing same-frequency sinusoids gives another sinusoid, merged via the auxiliary angle formula

examples.problem: 某地一天的气温近似满足 $T(t) = 10 + 8\sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{12}t - \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$（$t$ 为小时，$T$ 为摄氏度）。求该地的最高气温、最低气温与气温变化的周期。
examples.solution: 对照 $T = k + A\sin(\omega t + \varphi)$，得 $A = 8$，$k = 10$，$\omega = \dfrac{\pi}{12}$。故最高气温为 $k + A = 18^{\circ}\text{C}$，最低气温为 $k - A = 2^{\circ}\text{C}$。周期 $T = \dfrac{2\pi}{\omega} = \dfrac{2\pi}{\pi/12} = 24$ 小时，与一天的长度一致。

expression.note: 习惯上取 $A>0,\ \omega>0$；$|A|$ 才是振幅，$A<0$ 时可把负号并入相位。
expression.noteEn: Conventionally $A>0$ and $\omega>0$; the amplitude is $|A|$, and a negative $A$ can be absorbed into the phase.

triangle-identities.definition:
在三角形 $ABC$ 中，三个内角始终满足

$$A + B + C = \pi$$

这一简单事实带来了一组极其实用的**恒等变换**，因为它们把三个角捆在了一起：

$$\sin(A+B) = \sin C,\qquad \cos(A+B) = -\cos C,\qquad \tan(A+B) = -\tan C$$

以及半角与倍角层面的关系，例如 $\sin\dfrac{A+B}{2} = \cos\dfrac{C}{2}$。这些式子让「角落里」的角可以用另外两个角表示，从而在化简、判定形状、证明恒等式时大幅减少变量。

这类变换是解三角形与三角恒等式的交汇点：判断三角形形状、化简含 $A,B,C$ 的表达式、证明边角关系，几乎都要先做一次这样的转化。
triangle-identities.definitionEn:
In triangle $ABC$ the three interior angles always satisfy

$$A + B + C = \pi$$

This simple fact yields a set of highly useful **identities**, because the three angles are locked together:

$$\sin(A+B) = \sin C,\qquad \cos(A+B) = -\cos C,\qquad \tan(A+B) = -\tan C$$

and half-angle versions such as $\sin\dfrac{A+B}{2} = \cos\dfrac{C}{2}$. They let one angle be expressed through the other two, cutting down the number of variables when simplifying, classifying a triangle or proving an identity.

These transformations sit at the meeting point of solving triangles and trigonometric identities: classifying a triangle, simplifying expressions in $A,B,C$ and proving side-angle relations almost always begin with such a step.

formulas.note: 一切三角形恒等式的出发点，说明三个角独立变量只有两个。
formulas.noteEn: The starting point of every triangle identity; only two of the three angles are independent.

formulas.note: 因为 $A+B = \pi - C$，由诱导公式得到，是最常用的关系。
formulas.noteEn: Since $A+B = \pi - C$, this follows from reduction formulas; the most used relation.

formulas.note: 同理由 $\cos(\pi-C) = -\cos C$ 与 $\tan(\pi-C) = -\tan C$ 得到。
formulas.noteEn: Similarly from $\cos(\pi-C) = -\cos C$ and $\tan(\pi-C) = -\tan C$.

formulas.note: 半角关系，常用于含 $\dfrac{A+B}{2}$ 的化简。
formulas.noteEn: Half-angle relation, often used to simplify expressions with $\dfrac{A+B}{2}$.

formulas.latex: \tan A + \tan B + \tan C = \tan A\tan B\tan C
formulas.note: 当 $A+B+C = \pi$ 时的经典恒等式，用于含正切的三角形问题。
formulas.noteEn: A classical identity when $A+B+C = \pi$; handy for tangent-based problems.

properties: 三角形中至少有两个锐角，因此任意两角之和的正弦必为正
恒等式成立的前提是 $A,B,C$ 确实为同一三角形的三个内角
利用 $A = \pi - B - C$ 可把三变量问题化为两变量问题
当 $\tan A + \tan B + \tan C$ 中出现零或负值时可用来判断三角形为直角或钝角
$\sin 2A + \sin 2B + \sin 2C = 4\sin A\sin B\sin C$ 等对称恒等式常用于综合证明
propertiesEn: A triangle has at least two acute angles, so the sine of any two angles summed is positive
The identities assume $A,B,C$ are the interior angles of one triangle
Using $A = \pi - B - C$ reduces three variables to two
Signs of tangent expressions help detect right or obtuse triangles
Symmetric identities such as $\sin 2A + \sin 2B + \sin 2C = 4\sin A\sin B\sin C$ are used in proofs

examples.problem: 在 $\triangle ABC$ 中，已知 $\sin(A+B) = \dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$，求角 $C$。
examples.solution: 由三角形内角和 $A+B+C = \pi$，得 $A+B = \pi - C$，于是 $\sin(A+B) = \sin(\pi - C) = \sin C$。所以 $\sin C = \dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$。又因为 $0 < C < \pi$，故 $C = \dfrac{\pi}{4}$ 或 $C = \dfrac{3\pi}{4}$。

examples.problem: 在 $\triangle ABC$ 中（设三个角都不是直角），证明恒等式 $\tan A+\tan B+\tan C = \tan A\tan B\tan C$。
examples.solution: 由 $A+B = \pi - C$ 得 $\tan(A+B) = -\tan C$，而 $\tan(A+B) = \dfrac{\tan A + \tan B}{1 - \tan A\tan B}$。当 $\tan A\tan B \neq 1$ 时，交叉相乘得 $\tan A + \tan B = -\tan C(1 - \tan A\tan B) = -\tan C + \tan A\tan B\tan C$，移项恰好得到 $\tan A + \tan B + \tan C = \tan A\tan B\tan C$，即该恒等式成立。

pythagorean.definition:
在直角三角形中，设两条直角边长分别为 $a,b$，斜边长为 $c$，则有

$$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$$

这就是**勾股定理**（毕达哥拉斯定理）。它是平面几何中最著名的结论之一，也是三角学的起点：正因为有了它，才可能对一个锐角 $\theta$ 定义 $\sin\theta = \dfrac{\text{对边}}{\text{斜边}}$，$\cos\theta = \dfrac{\text{邻边}}{\text{斜边}}$，$\tan\theta = \dfrac{\text{对边}}{\text{邻边}}$——这些比值不依赖于三角形的大小，只依赖于角 $\theta$。

把勾股定理与三角比结合起来，可以立即得到恒等式 $\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1$；而余弦定理正是它在一般三角形上的推广。反过来，勾股定理的逆定理还能用来判定一个三角形是否为直角三角形。
pythagorean.definitionEn:
In a right triangle with legs $a,b$ and hypotenuse $c$,

$$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$$

This is the **Pythagorean theorem**, one of the most famous results in plane geometry and the starting point of trigonometry. It is what makes it possible to define, for an acute angle $\theta$, the ratios $\sin\theta = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}$, $\cos\theta = \dfrac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}}$ and $\tan\theta = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}$ — ratios that depend only on $\theta$, not on the size of the triangle.

Combining the theorem with these ratios immediately yields $\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1$, and the law of cosines is precisely its generalisation to arbitrary triangles. Conversely, the converse of the theorem identifies right triangles from their side lengths.

formulas.note: 直角三角形两直角边平方和等于斜边平方，全定理的核心。
formulas.noteEn: The core statement: legs squared add up to hypotenuse squared.

formulas.note: 已知两直角边求斜边，是实际计算中出现最多的形式。
formulas.noteEn: Find the hypotenuse from the two legs; the most frequent practical form.

formulas.note: 由勾股定理与三角比定义直接推出，是最基本的三角恒等式。
formulas.noteEn: Follows directly from the theorem and the ratio definitions; the most basic trigonometric identity.

formulas.latex: c\ \text{为最长边时：}\quad a^2+b^2>c^2\iff \text{角 }C\text{ 为锐角},\qquad a^2+b^2<c^2\iff \text{角 }C\text{ 为钝角}
formulas.note: 逆定理与推广：先找出最长边作为 c，再由三边判断三角形形状。
formulas.noteEn: Converse and extension: first identify the longest side as c, then classify the triangle from its three sides.

properties: 只对直角三角形成立，$c$ 必须是直角所对的斜边
逆定理成立：若三边满足 $a^2+b^2=c^2$，则该三角形是直角三角形
由它可以导出三角基本恒等式 $\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1$
余弦定理是其推广：当夹角为直角时 $2bc\cos A$ 项消失，公式退化为勾股定理
propertiesEn: Holds only for right triangles, with $c$ the hypotenuse opposite the right angle
The converse holds: if $a^2+b^2=c^2$ then the triangle is right-angled
Integer solutions are Pythagorean triples such as $(3,4,5)$, $(5,12,13)$, $(8,15,17)$ and their scalings
It yields the fundamental identity $\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1$
The law of cosines generalises it: when the included angle is right, the $2bc\cos A$ term vanishes

examples.problem: 直角三角形两直角边分别为 $6$ 和 $8$，求斜边长及较小锐角的正弦值。
examples.solution: 由勾股定理 $c = \sqrt{6^2 + 8^2} = \sqrt{36 + 64} = \sqrt{100} = 10$。设边 $6$ 所对的锐角为 $\theta$，则 $\sin\theta = \dfrac{\text{对边}}{\text{斜边}} = \dfrac{6}{10} = \dfrac{3}{5}$。所以斜边长为 $10$，较小锐角的正弦值为 $\dfrac{3}{5}$。

expression.note: $c$ 必须是斜边（直角所对的边）；直角三角形中斜边最长。
expression.noteEn: $c$ must be the hypotenuse, the side opposite the right angle, which is the longest side.

sum-to-product.definition:
三角函数的加法定理（如 $\sin(\alpha+\beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta$）把乘积与和联系起来。把这些公式两两相加减，就得到两族用途广泛的恒等式：

- **积化和差**：把三角函数的乘积写成和差，如 $\sin\alpha\cos\beta = \dfrac{1}{2}[\sin(\alpha+\beta) + \sin(\alpha-\beta)]$；
- **和差化积**：把三角函数的和差写成乘积，如 $\sin\alpha + \sin\beta = 2\sin\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\cos\dfrac{\alpha-\beta}{2}$。

这两族公式本质上是一回事——互为逆用。它们的价值在于「形式切换」：遇到乘积求和、解含余弦之差的方程、或者需要对波形进行叠加时，切换到更简单的形式往往能一步化简。它们也是傅里叶分析和信号处理的基础工具。
sum-to-product.definitionEn:
The addition theorems (such as $\sin(\alpha+\beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta$) link products to sums. Adding and subtracting pairs of them produces two families of widely used identities:

- **Product-to-sum**: turn a product into a sum or difference, e.g. $\sin\alpha\cos\beta = \dfrac{1}{2}[\sin(\alpha+\beta) + \sin(\alpha-\beta)]$;
- **Sum-to-product**: turn a sum or difference into a product, e.g. $\sin\alpha + \sin\beta = 2\sin\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\cos\dfrac{\alpha-\beta}{2}$.

The two families are really one — each is the reverse of the other. Their value is form-switching: summing products, solving equations containing differences of cosines, or superposing waves all become one-step simplifications. They are also foundational in Fourier analysis and signal processing.

formulas.note: 和差化积：正弦之和化为「半和的正弦乘半差的余弦」。
formulas.noteEn: Sum-to-product for sine: sine of the half-sum times cosine of the half-difference.

formulas.note: 正弦之差化为乘积，注意此处是余弦乘正弦。
formulas.noteEn: Difference of sines as a product; note it is cosine times sine.

formulas.note: 余弦之和化为两余弦之积，是四式中符号最简单的。
formulas.noteEn: Sum of cosines as a product of two cosines; the simplest of the four.

formulas.note: 余弦之差化为乘积，务必不要漏掉前面的负号。
formulas.noteEn: Difference of cosines; do not forget the leading minus sign.

formulas.note: 积化和差：正弦乘余弦化为两个正弦之和的一半。
formulas.noteEn: Product-to-sum: sine times cosine as half the sum of two sines.

formulas.note: 积化和差中的正弦乘正弦，括号内顺序为「差减和」。
formulas.noteEn: Product of two sines; the bracket is difference minus sum.

properties: 和差化积与积化和差互为逆运算，可任选方向使用
和差化积的结果中只出现半和 $\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{2}$ 与半差 $\dfrac{\alpha-\beta}{2}$ 两个角
系数的规律：正弦和差系数为 $2$，乘积化为和差时系数为 $\dfrac{1}{2}$
符号规律：余弦之差 $\cos\alpha - \cos\beta$ 前有负号，$\cos\alpha + \cos\beta$ 无负号
是导数公式、傅里叶级数与交流电波形叠加的重要预备工具
propertiesEn: Sum-to-product and product-to-sum are inverses; use whichever direction helps
Sum-to-product results involve only the half-sum $\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{2}$ and half-difference $\dfrac{\alpha-\beta}{2}$
Coefficient pattern: sums-to-products carry a factor $2$, products-to-sums a factor $\dfrac{1}{2}$
Sign pattern: $\cos\alpha - \cos\beta$ carries a minus sign while the sum does not
A key preparatory tool for derivatives, Fourier series and superposing AC waveforms

examples.problem: 化简 $\dfrac{\sin 2\alpha + \sin 2\beta}{\cos 2\alpha + \cos 2\beta}$。
examples.solution: 由和差化积公式，$\sin 2\alpha + \sin 2\beta = 2\sin(\alpha+\beta)\cos(\alpha-\beta)$，$\cos 2\alpha + \cos 2\beta = 2\cos(\alpha+\beta)\cos(\alpha-\beta)$。因为 $\cos(\alpha-\beta) \neq 0$ 时可约去，得原式 $= \dfrac{2\sin(\alpha+\beta)\cos(\alpha-\beta)}{2\cos(\alpha+\beta)\cos(\alpha-\beta)} = \tan(\alpha+\beta)$。

examples.problem: 化简 $\sin 40^{\circ} + \sin 20^{\circ}$。
examples.solution: 由和差化积公式，$\sin 40^{\circ} + \sin 20^{\circ} = 2\sin\dfrac{40^{\circ}+20^{\circ}}{2}\cos\dfrac{40^{\circ}-20^{\circ}}{2} = 2\sin 30^{\circ}\cos 10^{\circ} = 2 \times \dfrac{1}{2} \times \cos 10^{\circ} = \cos 10^{\circ}$。

expression.text: sin α + sin β = 2 sin((α+β)/2) cos((α−β)/2)
expression.note: 口诀：「和差化积，半和半差；积化和差，和差相加减」。
expression.noteEn: Mnemonic: half-sum and half-difference for sum-to-product; add or subtract angle sums for product-to-sum.

acute-trigonometry.definition:
在直角三角形中，边和角之间有确定的对应关系。设 Rt△ABC 中 $\angle C=90^\circ$，并记 $\angle A$ 的对边为 $a$（即 BC）、邻边为 $b$（即 AC）、斜边为 $c$（即 AB）。当锐角 A 的大小确定后，不管三角形画得多大，三个比值 $\dfrac{a}{c}$、$\dfrac{b}{c}$、$\dfrac{a}{b}$ 都保持不变，这是因为相似三角形的对应边成比例。正因为比值只与角的大小有关，我们才能给它们起名字：

$$\sin A=\frac{\angle A\ \text{的对边}}{\text{斜边}}=\frac{a}{c},$$
$$\cos A=\frac{\angle A\ \text{的邻边}}{\text{斜边}}=\frac{b}{c},$$
$$\tan A=\frac{\angle A\ \text{的对边}}{\angle A\ \text{的邻边}}=\frac{a}{b}.$$

它们分别叫做 $\angle A$ 的**正弦**、**余弦**、**正切**，统称为锐角 A 的**锐角三角函数**。注意「对边」「邻边」都是相对于所研究的角说的，换了角就要换边。由勾股定理可知斜边最长，所以 $0<\sin A<1$，$0<\cos A<1$，而 $\tan A>0$。

特殊角的三角函数值必须记牢：$\sin30^\circ=\dfrac12$，$\cos30^\circ=\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$，$\tan30^\circ=\dfrac{\sqrt3}{3}$；$\sin45^\circ=\cos45^\circ=\dfrac{\sqrt2}{2}$，$\tan45^\circ=1$（此时直角三角形是等腰直角三角形）；$\sin60^\circ=\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$，$\cos60^\circ=\dfrac12$，$\tan60^\circ=\sqrt3$。可以抓住规律记忆：30°、45°、60° 的正弦值依次是 $\dfrac{\sqrt1}{2}$、$\dfrac{\sqrt2}{2}$、$\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$；30° 与 60° 的正弦、余弦值恰好互换。

同一锐角还有两个常用关系：$\sin^2A+\cos^2A=1$（由勾股定理 $a^2+b^2=c^2$ 两边除以 $c^2$ 得到），$\tan A=\dfrac{\sin A}{\cos A}$。此外，如果 $\angle A+\angle B=90^\circ$，那么 $\sin A=\cos B$，即 $\sin A=\cos(90^\circ-A)$。已知直角三角形的两条边，或已知一条边和一个锐角，就可以求出其余的边和角，这叫做**解直角三角形**。
acute-trigonometry.definitionEn:
In a right triangle the sides and angles are linked by fixed ratios. Let Rt△ABC have $\angle C=90^\circ$, and denote by $a$ (that is BC) the side opposite $\angle A$, by $b$ (that is AC) the side adjacent to $\angle A$, and by $c$ (that is AB) the hypotenuse. Once the acute angle A is fixed, the three ratios $\dfrac{a}{c}$, $\dfrac{b}{c}$ and $\dfrac{a}{b}$ stay the same no matter how large the triangle is drawn, because corresponding sides of similar triangles are proportional. Since the ratios depend only on the angle, they deserve names:

$$\sin A=\frac{\text{side opposite }\angle A}{\text{hypotenuse}}=\frac{a}{c},$$
$$\cos A=\frac{\text{side adjacent to }\angle A}{\text{hypotenuse}}=\frac{b}{c},$$
$$\tan A=\frac{\text{side opposite }\angle A}{\text{side adjacent to }\angle A}=\frac{a}{b}.$$

They are the **sine**, **cosine** and **tangent** of $\angle A$, collectively the **trigonometric ratios of the acute angle A**. Note that 'opposite' and 'adjacent' are always understood with respect to the chosen angle. Because the hypotenuse is the longest side, $0<\sin A<1$, $0<\cos A<1$, while $\tan A>0$.

The special values must be memorized: $\sin30^\circ=\dfrac12$, $\cos30^\circ=\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$, $\tan30^\circ=\dfrac{\sqrt3}{3}$; $\sin45^\circ=\cos45^\circ=\dfrac{\sqrt2}{2}$, $\tan45^\circ=1$ (the triangle is then isosceles right-angled); $\sin60^\circ=\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$, $\cos60^\circ=\dfrac12$, $\tan60^\circ=\sqrt3$. A useful pattern: the sines of 30°, 45°, 60° can be written as $\dfrac{\sqrt1}{2}$, $\dfrac{\sqrt2}{2}$, $\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$, and the sine and cosine of 30° and 60° simply swap.

Two identities hold for every acute angle: $\sin^2A+\cos^2A=1$ (divide $a^2+b^2=c^2$ by $c^2$) and $\tan A=\dfrac{\sin A}{\cos A}$. Also, if $\angle A+\angle B=90^\circ$ then $\sin A=\cos B$, i.e. $\sin A=\cos(90^\circ-A)$. Knowing two sides, or one side and one acute angle, of a right triangle, we can find all remaining sides and angles — this is called **solving a right triangle**.

formulas.note: 正弦 = 对边 ÷ 斜边；对边、邻边是相对于所研究的锐角 A 而言的。
formulas.noteEn: Sine = opposite side ÷ hypotenuse; 'opposite' and 'adjacent' are understood with respect to the chosen acute angle A.

formulas.note: 余弦 = 邻边 ÷ 斜边。
formulas.noteEn: Cosine = adjacent side ÷ hypotenuse.

formulas.latex: \tan A=\dfrac{\angle A\ \text{的对边}}{\angle A\ \text{的邻边}}=\dfrac{a}{b}=\dfrac{\sin A}{\cos A}
formulas.note: 正切 = 对边 ÷ 邻边，也等于正弦与余弦的比。
formulas.noteEn: Tangent = opposite ÷ adjacent, which also equals sin A / cos A.

formulas.note: 三个特殊角的三角函数值：30°、45°、60° 的正弦值依次是 √1/2、√2/2、√3/2；30° 与 60° 的正弦、余弦值互换。
formulas.noteEn: The special values for 30°, 45°, 60°: their sines are √1/2, √2/2, √3/2, and sine and cosine interchange between 30° and 60°.

formulas.note: 同角关系：由勾股定理 a²+b²=c² 两边除以 c² 得到，常用来求值、化简和检验。
formulas.noteEn: Same-angle relations (divide a²+b²=c² by c²); useful for evaluating, simplifying and checking.

properties: 角一定，三个比值就确定，与三角形的大小无关（相似三角形对应边成比例）。
取值范围：0<sin A<1，0<cos A<1，tan A>0（锐角情形）。
同角关系：sin²A+cos²A=1，tan A=sin A/cos A。
互余关系：若 ∠A+∠B=90°，则 sin A=cos B，即 sin A=cos(90°−A)；同样有 cos A=sin(90°−A)。
解直角三角形：已知两条边（可用勾股定理），或已知一边和一锐角，就能求出其余的边和角。
propertiesEn: Once the angle is fixed the three ratios are fixed, independent of the size of the triangle (similar triangles have proportional sides).
Ranges for an acute angle: 0<sin A<1, 0<cos A<1 and tan A>0.
Same-angle relations: sin²A+cos²A=1 and tan A=sin A/cos A.
Complementary angles: if ∠A+∠B=90° then sin A=cos B, i.e. sin A=cos(90°−A), and likewise cos A=sin(90°−A).
Solving a right triangle: two sides (with the Pythagorean theorem), or one side plus one acute angle, determine all the rest.

examples.problem: 在 Rt△ABC 中，$\angle C=90^\circ$，$a=BC=3$，$b=AC=4$。(1) 求斜边 c；(2) 求 sin A、cos A、tan A；(3) 求 sin B，并说明它与 cos A 的关系。
examples.solution:
(1) 由勾股定理：$c=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}=\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=\sqrt{25}=5$。

(2) ∠A 的对边 a=3，邻边 b=4，斜边 c=5，所以
$\sin A=\dfrac{a}{c}=\dfrac35=0.6$，$\cos A=\dfrac{b}{c}=\dfrac45=0.8$，$\tan A=\dfrac{a}{b}=\dfrac34=0.75$。

(3) ∠B 的对边是 b=4，斜边仍是 c=5，所以 $\sin B=\dfrac{b}{c}=\dfrac45=\cos A$。这与互余关系一致：$\angle A+\angle B=90^\circ$，$\sin B=\cos(90^\circ-B)=\cos A$。

验证同角关系：$\sin^2A+\cos^2A=\left(\dfrac35\right)^2+\left(\dfrac45\right)^2=\dfrac{9}{25}+\dfrac{16}{25}=1$。

examples.problem: 在 Rt△ABC 中，$\angle C=90^\circ$，$\angle A=30^\circ$，斜边 $c=10$，解这个直角三角形（求 ∠B、a、b）。
examples.solution:
$\angle B=90^\circ-\angle A=90^\circ-30^\circ=60^\circ$。

$a=c\cdot\sin A=10\times\sin30^\circ=10\times\dfrac12=5$。

$b=c\cdot\cos A=10\times\cos30^\circ=10\times\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}=5\sqrt3\approx8.66$。

检验（勾股定理）：$a^2+b^2=5^2+(5\sqrt3)^2=25+75=100=10^2=c^2$，结果正确。

expression.text: sin A = a/c，cos A = b/c，tan A = a/b
expression.note: 直角三角形中锐角 A 的三种三角函数值，a、b、c 分别是 ∠A 的对边、邻边与斜边。
expression.noteEn: The three ratios of the acute angle A; a, b and c are the opposite side, adjacent side and hypotenuse of ∠A.
